keystone: Keystone pricing: a shop sets its retail price at double the wholesale price it paid. That is why many shops ask for a wholesale price near half your retail price.
keystoneNote: It's a common habit, not a rule. Some shops want a bigger cut, some pay more for consignment terms. Ask each shop what they need before you print prices.
termsToSet: Minimum first order (in dollars or units)
Case pack (how many of each item come in a box)
Payment terms (paid upfront, or due within a set number of days)
Lead time (days from order to ship)
